games.title: All Hail the Cook-o-tron
games.description: All Hail the Cook-o-tron is a physics-based VR cooking game. Play as a contender in a competition designed to hone your cooking skills to ultimately please the robotic food critic known as the Cook-o-tron.

games.title: 올인원 스포츠 /All In One Sports
games.description: 16 가지 스포츠게임을 '올인원 스포츠' 하나로 ! 16 개의 인기 스포츠 게임을 하나의 타이틀로 통합 개발하였습니다. 비대면 가상현실 스포츠를 안전하고 리얼하게 즐길 수있는 최고의 선택입니다.

games.source_name: All In One Summer Sports VR
games.title: 올인원 썸머 스포츠 VR /All In One Summer Sports VR
games.description: 단 하나의 게임으로 11가지 여름 스포츠! 최고의 여름 모험을 시작하세요. 숨 막히는 열대 섬에서 다양한 스포츠의 짜릿함을 경험하세요. 단순한 게임이 아니라, 여러분만의 개인적인 여름 낙원, 스포츠로 가득 차고 햇볕이 내리쬐는 가상 휴가로의 티켓입니다.

games.title: All On Board!
games.description: Built for board game lovers, All On Board! brings back the magic of game nights to VR/MR. Enjoy adapted versions of your favorite titles with friends, lifelike physics, and thoughtful design that make every match feel real, like gathering around a table wherever you are.

games.title: ALTAIR BREAKER
games.description: Enter the world of ALTAIR and battle against the LAWS, an army of corrupted AI left behind roaming the floating Vastus Isle. Team up with friends and experience the feeling of transcendent VR sword fighting in this map-based multiplayer adventure. Climb, glide, and slice your way through beautifully-crafted levels and collect resources to upgrade your character while playing with friends.

games.title: ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos
games.description:
“The story to draw and the big scale production that makes full use of robot battle are excellent.” 9/10 – IGN Japan
ALTDEUS features 15-20 hours of gameplay with one of the largest branching storylines ever in a VR game. Your choices and actions branch the story leading to multiple endings.

This game contains multiple unlockable paths - don't stop playing at the first credits roll!

This game is highly recommended for people who don’t have a high tolerance against motion sickness.

games.title: Alvo
games.description:
Crossplay with all major VR headsets.

A high‑octane multiplayer shooter built for players who want speed, strategy, and seamless cross‑platform action. Alvo delivers fast, addictive VR combat with tight controls, tactical movement, and a full suite of competitive and co‑op modes. Jump into intense firefights, master your loadouts, and squad up across platforms in close‑quarters maps and objective‑based missions.

games.title: AMAS AppLab
games.description:
This is not a game.
 
Application for physical robot control using VR with 3D camera input.
 
Experience above in simulation without hardware components.
 
For hardware integration contact Extend Robotics.

games.title: Amazing Maze VR
games.description:
Amazing Maze VR
A fun VR puzzle game where you explore and navigate through a twisting 3D maze. Start at the entrance, find your way to the finish.  Simple controls, immersive design, and a relaxing seated experience make it perfect for quick play sessions.

Get in early and avoid price rises! Amazing Maze is under rapid development — upcoming features include a scoring system, leaderboards, timers, traps, treasure, and collectible badges.

games.title: Amber of Jinn
games.description: Amber of Jinn is a recurring nightmare you can’t escape, a VR survival horror game developed by Stixor Technologies.  Every night, contend with spirits from pre-Islamic folklore without going mad. Explore a liminal post-colonial maze and become a student of dream logic or perish before you wake up.

games.title: AmblyoPunch
games.description: Amblyopunch is a Meta Quest VR app by Seven Sportz for training amblyopia (lazy eye). Using dichoptic training, it teaches eyes to work together through four clinical stages: monocular warm-up, suppression breaking, rebalancing, and fusion. Users punch Gabor coins and dodge spikes to stimulate the visual cortex and improve coordination. The app adapts to condition severity and eye alignment of lazy eye, such as esotropia or exotropia.

games.title: Ambulance Life
games.description: A realistic VR ambulance simulation where every second matters. Drive through city traffic, respond to emergencies, and save lives.

games.source_name: Ambulance Rush - Ambulance Driving & Rescue Simulator
games.title: Ambulance Rush - Ambulance Driving & Rescue Simulator
games.description: Ambulance rush: a thrilling driving game where you race through diverse city locations to rescue lives. Perform realistic first aid tasks, navigate obstacles, ensure safe transport to the hospital and become the hero your city needs!

games.title: Amelia's Escape
games.description:
Amelia’s Escape is a VR escape room with an interwoven narrative! Take on the character of Amelia to solve puzzles to escape the room of a time travel obsessed scientist!

Will you be able to escape?

games.title: Amid Evil
games.description:
A retro FPS for the ages! Completely rebuilt from the ground up for VR! 

Once branded a HERETIC. Now YOU have been chosen as our champion! Reclaim our sacred weapons. Take back our ancient lands. If you can stand... AMID EVIL.

games.source_name: Ammonia Diffusion Experiment - ContentsDa Science Experiment
games.title: Ammonia Diffusion Experiment - ContentsDa Science Experiment
games.description: Step into the world of gases and discover how they move and mix. The Ammonia Diffusion Experiment provides a captivating visual demonstration of gas diffusion, showing how molecules spread to fill available space.

games.title: Among Giants
games.description:
EXPLORE, HUNT & KILL THE GIANTS.
You are Erya, the lone wanderer on a desolate world. You awaken among colossal giants, with their slow, deliberate movements resembling ancient deities. The world is scattered with robot relics, frozen in anguish, remnants of a lost civilization destroyed by a divine event. Can you uncover a connection between the giants, the planet, and your own origins?

games.title: Among Mini Golf
games.description:
Among Mini Golf
Relax, play, and explore in Among Mini Golf! A cozy mini golf adventure with lots of fun and challenging levels. Each course is uniquely designed to test your skills while keeping the vibe lighthearted and relaxing. Perfect for quick play sessions or winding down after a long day.

games.title: Among Us VR
games.description: 데피니티브 소셜 추리 파티 게임이 3D로 찾아왔습니다! 과연 크루원들이 살아남을 수 있을까요? 아니면 임포스터가 이길까요? 배신, 긴급회의, 역할, 사보타주, 작업 등 오리지널 Among Us의 혼돈을 3D 속에서 즐기세요.
games.developer: Schell Games, Innersloth, and Robot Teddy

games.title: Amusement Rides
games.description:
"Research for a more realistic experience than reality"

Amusement Rides offers a variety of rides and has conducted various studies to provide augmented reality.

1. You can experience augmented reality rides.
2. You can enjoy racing games by riding an augmented reality sports car.
3. You can pilot an augmented reality airplane.

If you write what you want on the homepage,
we will try to reflect it immediately.

We are working hard to develop better games,
and we appreciate your interest.

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Complete Set
games.description: Explore the entire human body in VR with the Complete Set of Anatomy Learning Labs. Featuring anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and activities designed by professors, this collection includes the skeletal, muscular, cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, neural, and sensory systems. Scan, explore, grab, assemble, and test your knowledge through immersive multimodal learning experiences available at elementary, middle, and high school difficulty levels.

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Digestive Lab
games.description: Step into an immersive VR digestive system laboratory and explore how the human body processes food in stunning 3D. Travel through medical imaging views, examine digestive organs using natural hand-tracking, and hear Dr. Hana Sato identify anatomical structures by name. Assemble digestive anatomy in interactive 3D puzzles, test your knowledge with quizzes, and reinforce learning through engaging challenges designed to make anatomy memorable and fun.

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Exploration Lab
games.description: Step into an immersive VR anatomy laboratory and explore the major systems of the human body in stunning 3D. Travel through medical imaging views, examine anatomical structures using natural hand-tracking, and hear Dr. Hana Sato identify structures by name. Explore organs, tissues, and cells from multiple body systems, then reinforce your learning by assembling a human heart in an engaging 3D puzzle challenge designed to make anatomy memorable and fun.

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Muscular Lab
games.description: Step into an immersive VR muscular system laboratory and explore how the human body moves and generates force in stunning 3D. Travel through medical imaging views, examine muscles using natural hand-tracking, and hear Dr. Hana Sato identify anatomical structures by name and explain their functions. Assemble muscular anatomy in an interactive 3D puzzle, test your knowledge with quizzes, and reinforce learning through engaging challenges designed to make anatomy more memorable and fun.

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Neural Lab
games.description:
Step into an immersive VR neural system laboratory and explore the communication network of the
human body in stunning 3D. Travel through medical imaging views, examine the brain, spinal cord,
and peripheral nerves using natural hand-tracking, and hear Dr. Hana Sato identify anatomical
structures by name. Assemble neural pathways in interactive 3D puzzles, test your knowledge with
quizzes, and reinforce learning through engaging challenges designed to make neuroscience exciting,
memorable, and f

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Respiratory Lab
games.description: Step into an immersive VR respiratory system laboratory and explore how the human body breathes in stunning 3D. Travel through medical imaging views, examine the lungs, airways, and alveoli using natural hand-tracking, and hear Dr. Hana Sato identify anatomical structures by name. Assemble respiratory anatomy in interactive 3D puzzles, test your knowledge with quizzes, and reinforce learning through engaging challenges designed to make anatomy memorable and fun.

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Sensory Lab
games.description: Step into a sensory system lab and explore how the human body sees, hears, smells, and tastes in stunning 3D. Travel through medical imaging views, examine the eye, ear, tongue, and sensory regions of the brain using natural hand-tracking, and hear Dr. Hana Sato identify anatomical structures by name. Assemble the human eye in interactive 3D puzzles, test your knowledge with quizzes, and reinforce learning through engaging challenges designed to make anatomy memorable and fun.

games.title: Anatomy Learning Labs: Skeletal Lab
games.description: Step into an immersive VR skeletal system laboratory and explore the framework of the human body in stunning 3D. Travel through medical imaging views, examine bones from every angle using natural hand-tracking, and hear Dr. Hana Sato identify anatomical structures by name. Assemble the human skeleton in interactive 3D puzzles, test your knowledge with quizzes, and reinforce learning through fast-paced challenges designed to make anatomy engaging, memorable, and fun.

games.title: Anatomy of a Chicken
games.description: Anatomy of the chicken allows users to develop and test their knowledge of the anatomy of both a broiler and layer chicken. Users can explore different layers of the chicken including skeletal, muscular, organs and reproductive systems.

games.title: Ancient Dungeon
games.description: Ancient Dungeon is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler featuring physics-based combat, procedurally-generated layouts, and 20+ hours of content and 4 player coop multiplayer. Ancient dungeon is actively still being updated and one of the highest rated Dungeon Crawler on Quest.

games.title: Android Assault
games.description: Androids were created to obey and make people's lives easier but a glitch in the software changed all that. Older model Androids have gone rogue and have started attacking civilians. The government has assigned their latest and most advanced Android to take out the older models.

games.title: AnExplorer VR File Manager Pro
games.description: AnExplorer VR File Manager Pro is a fast, powerful VR file manager for Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest 3S, and Quest Pro. Wirelessly transfer files between your headset, phone, tablet, or Computer. Manage internal storage, SD cards, USB drives, cloud storage, and network storages. View images, play audio and video, extract ZIP, RAR, TAR, and 7z archives.  View PDF files and edit Text files easily. Enjoy complete VR file management, file organisation, and wireless media transfer without cables.

games.title: Angelino Drift
games.description: An open-world driving sandbox where drifting turns you into a high-speed weapon. Race against time, shoot rival cars, smash through the city, and keep the bomb from detonating.

games.title: Angry Bee: Protect My Pet
games.description: 그려서 구하세요! 3D 공간에 보호막을 그려 성난 벌떼로부터 귀여운 반려동물을 보호하는 미션입니다.

games.source_name: Angry Birds VR: Isle of Pigs
games.title: Angry Birds VR: Isle of Pigs
games.description: 몰입감 넘치는 VR 모험 앵그리버드 VR: 아일 오브 피그에서 도난당한 알을 구하기 위해 레드, 척, 밤 및 블루와 함께하세요! 탐욕스러운 녹색 돼지가 휴가를 보내는 외딴 섬을 찾아보십시오! 이국적인 해변, 가파른 절벽 및 눈 덮인 슬로프를 통해 104개의 재미있는 레벨에서 새총을 쏘세요. 진짜 중요한 스타를 얻으려면 가장 멋진 방법으로 건물을 파괴하십시오. 그리고 온라인 레벨 빌더로 무한한 레벨을 만들고, 공유하고, 발견해 보세요!

games.title: Angry Pigs
games.description:
Fight for your life and defend your precious crops in this action-packed shooter.

Uncle Frank went to visit his daughter in the city for the weekend. He accidentally forgot to feed his pigs. Pigs are hungry and are now running around the farm eating everything they find. 
Help uncle Frank keep his crops by shooting piggies back to the barn. When you shoot a piggy, it returns to the barn, but be fast, there’s hundreds of them coming back to eat your crops. Watch out cause they bite too.

games.title: Angry Universe VR
games.description: Welcome to a VR game where you rule the universe! Break stuff, enjoy gravity physics, and survive natural disasters. And the best part? Fight off aliens using several guns or even asteroids. Try everything you can to keep your home solar system safe from the dangers out there!

games.title: Animal Anatomy XR
games.description:
Are you ready to Explore your favorite Animals?
Understand your pet like never before with Animal Anatomy XR!

Animal Anatomy XR offers an intuitive and immersive experience, designed for anyone interested in the Animal Anatomy. Interact, learn and explore thousands of anatomical structures using interactive tools.

Dive into a world where learning meets innovation, and explore Animal Anatomy like never before!

games.title: Animal Dash
games.description: Welcome to the wild and whimsical world of "Animal Dash"! You'll play as an adorable animal and navigate through the breathtaking environments. Sounds cool right? Get ready to swing your arms and unleash the calorie within that!

games.title: Animal Hunter
games.description: If you enjoy adrenaline and adventure, Animal Hunter is your game! Explore wild landscapes and face thrilling challenges with lions, hippos, wild boars, crocodiles, deer, rabbits, and a variety of birds. Realistic graphics and fun gameplay make each mission exciting, where survival skills and precision define success. Get ready for unforgettable adventures in the wild!

games.source_name: Animal Hunter VR: Wild Shooting Games
games.title: Animal Hunter VR: Wild Shooting Games
games.description: Join the ultimate safari adventure in Animal Hunter VR! Explore breathtakingly realistic environments, encounter majestic animals, and master a range of hunting tools. Start on challenging missions, from tracking and photography to conservation. Download now on Meta Quest and unleash your inner wild hunter!

games.title: Animal Hunting Simulator: VR Sniper
games.description: Experience the thrill of the wild in Animal Hunting Simulator: VR Sniper! Immerse yourself in realistic environments where you can practice your shooting skills on various targets. Hunt forest animals to test your survival instincts and track down wild game in stunning VR landscapes. With advanced sniper mechanics and lifelike graphics, this game offers an exhilarating hunting experience. Perfect your aim and become the ultimate marksman as you explore diverse terrains.

games.title: Animal Keeper
games.description: Animal Keeper is a VR adventure where you explore vibrant biomes such as farms, plains, deserts, jungles, and glaciers to capture elusive animals and enchanting butterflies. Equipped with a butterfly net, hunting net, tranquilizer gun, baited cage, metal detector, and shovel, you gather repair treasures to restore your zoo enclosures and expand your animal collection. Enjoy a thrilling blend of exploration, hunting, and zoo restoration in this dynamic game.

games.title: Anomaly
games.description:
Anomaly is a high-stakes, built-for-VR PvPvE shooter.

Risk everything as you fight through a disaster-stricken city, gun down unearthly creatures, and outsmart rival players. 

Beat the clock to extract with powerful gear and upgrade your loadout - then do it all over again. 

Will you survive the Anomaly?

games.title: Another Door: Escape Room
games.description:
목표는 간단합니다. 
문을 열고 탈출하세요!

논리에 도전하고 재치를 시험하는 방탈출 게임 '어나더도어'로 초대합니다. 입장하는 순간부터 솔로 또는 친구들과 협력 플레이를 하기에 완벽한 구성으로 여러분은 다양하고 기발한 퍼즐과 마주하게 됩니다. 몰입형 VR을 위해 섬세하게 설계된 다양한 에피소드의 모험들과 실제와 같은 탈출의 스릴을 가상 현실을 통해 경험할 수 있습니다. 예측할 수 없는 시나리오에 빠져 단서를 파헤치고 진실에 접근하여 흥미진진한 '어나더도어'의 세계에 빠져 보세요!

games.title: Anshar 2: Hyperdrive
games.description:
- Update #2 available! new map, new weapons, more languages and voice overs !

DOGFIGHT! Take the role of a newly enlisted pilot in the deadliest squad in the Ansharian arsenal. Bring the fight to the Nergals in dazzling ship-to-ship battles in deep space and planetary surfaces by steering your ship using your hand, in third or first person view.

Fly a variety of ships across 13 missions single player campaign. 
Engage other players in multiplayers Battle Royale, Deathmatch or Coop missions.

games.title: Antiprism
games.description: Fight your way through bands of space pirates, armies of the Selysian Dominion, swarms of insect-like Kheelee, and even face Vel Selysian - the mysterious prophet-like leader of the Dominion.

games.title: Apex Construct
games.description: 아펙스 컨스트렉트는 스토리 중심의 싱글 플레이어 VR 액션/어드벤처입니다. 산산히 부서진 세계에서 신비를 탐구하고 해결하면서 업그레이드 가능한 활 & 방패 조합을 휘둘러 적과 싸우십시오.

games.source_name: ApexX Racing ChampionShip By Winter Art
games.title: ApexX Racing ChampionShip By Winter Art
games.description: Get ready for high-speed VR racing in **ApexX Racing Championship by Winter Art**! Experience intense races, explore 5 challenging tracks, and check out the new Live Showroom. Pre-order now and get ready to race!

games.title: Apocalypse Rush Racing
games.description: Apocalypse Rush Racing throws you into a high-speed VR death race inside a ruined nuclear power plant overrun by zombies. Join a ruthless racing gang, pilot heavily armed vehicles, and blast your way through radioactive tracks where survival is just as important as speed.

games.title: Apocalypse Zombie: Last Stand
games.description: Defend the final fortress in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Survive the last stand in VR.

games.title: Apollo 11
games.description: Apollo 11 is the story of the greatest journey ever taken by humankind. Apollo 11 is a complete remake of the very popular Apollo 11 VR which was a launch title on the Oculus Rift. This new version has all new assets, new textures, new animation, new lighting and revamped audio. Take one small step today and climb aboard Apollo 11 for the journey of a lifetime.

games.title: Aqua Adventure Aquarium
games.description:
Dive into the Enchanting World of Sea Creatures at Aqua Adventure Aquarium!

Discover and Explore:
•	Over 50 Sea Creatures: Walk around and marvel at 3D models of dolphins, sharks, octopuses, clownfish, whales, and more. 
•	Shipwreck Reef: Visit this mysterious area where you might encounter gentle manta rays or come face-to-face with deadly sharks.
•	Abyss Adventure Explorer: Hold your breath and dive underwater in our Scuba Cart to explore uncharted territories.

games.title: Aqua Glide
games.description: Aqua Glide is an exhilarating VR Jet Ski racing game that immerses you in breathtaking aquatic environments. Experience the thrill of high-speed water battles as you compete against friends or players worldwide in intense 4-player multiplayer matches. With arcade-style gameplay and realistic graphics, Aqua Glide delivers an adrenaline-fueled adventure on the waves.

games.title: Aqua Strike
games.description: Aqua Strike takes you on a thrilling aquatic adventure with Race and Chase modes, exciting challenges, and customizable boats and jet skis. Master the game with realistic two-handed controls, featuring a virtual steering wheel and bike-like handle. Equip powerful weapons to outmaneuver and outgun opponents. Get ready for speed, action, and nonstop excitement!

games.title: AquaPoloX
games.description: Dive into an immersive water polo experience with AquaPolo X.

games.title: 아쿠아리움 어드벤처
games.description: 혼합 현실로 방을 생동감 넘치는 인터랙티브 수족관으로 바꿔보세요.

games.title: Aquarium Survivors MR
games.description:
[MR (Mixed Reality) x Aquarium x Vampire Survivor-like]
Control a sea urchin and survive in an aquarium that appears in the real world!
A new type of MR survivor-like game set in a virtual aquarium!

games.title: AR Choppers
games.description:
Fly 16 amazing helicopters around your room in mixed-reality or experience them at actual size!  Fire guns and missiles to destroy targets!  Spray crops!  Fight fires!  Transport troops!  Heavy lift!

Check out "AR Planes" for more indoor flight!

games.title: AR Planes
games.description: Fly 17 famous U.S. warplanes in mixed-reality or explore them at actual size!  Fire guns, launch missiles, and drop bombs to destroy targets!

games.source_name: Arashi: Castles of Sin - Final Cut
games.title: Arashi: Castles of Sin - Final Cut
games.description: Become one with the shadows with the award winning VR shinobi adventure. Master the art of stealth-action as you infiltrate castles across feudal Japan with your arsenal of weapons, tools, and techniques, outwitting all enemies on your quest to defeat the Six Oni of Iga.

games.title: Arcade Legend
games.description:
THE MOST AUTHENTIC ARCADE EXPERIENCE OUTSIDE THE REAL WORLD
Build and customize your own arcade while playing officially licensed games with friends! Manage your business and build your reputation or explore other entertainment venues in your neighborhood. Play with up to 4 friends in multiplayer and compete for high scores on global leaderboards. It's the ultimate night out from the comfort of your living room!

games.title: Arcade Manager Simulator
games.description: 궁극의 아케이드 운영 시뮬레이션에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 나만의 레트로 게임 천국을 운영하는 꿈을 꾸어본 적이 있나요? 아케이드 매니저 시뮬레이터에서 몰입도 높은 1인칭 경영 및 생활 시뮬레이션을 경험해 보세요. 적은 자본과 작은 카페 공간에서 시작하여, 당신의 기업가적 역량을 최대한 발휘해 거대한 엔터테인먼트 제국을 건설해 나가세요!

games.title: Arcade Paradise VR
games.description: Arcade Paradise VR에서 레트로 향수가 가득한 1993년으로 돌아가 몰입감 넘치는 경험을 즐기세요. 빨래 사업으로 시작하여 부자로 가는 여정을 그린 Arcade Paradise는 어드벤처와 가벼운 매니지먼트 시뮬레이션이 조합된 게임으로, King Wash 빨래방을 잘 나가는 사업체로 키워야 합니다.

games.title: Arcade Ranger
games.description: Welcome to the wild world of Arcade Ranger! Get ready to squad up, customize every corner of your arcade, and bring the heat in this epic multiplayer adventure. Are you ready to face the craziest arcade battles and prove you’re the GOAT Arcade Ranger? Step up and show the Game Over Gang who’s in charge!

games.title: Arcane Flight: RC plane Sim
games.description:
Arcane Flight is a radio-controlled aircraft flight simulator set in a breathtaking fantasy world!

Here you can enjoy calm, relaxing flights and smooth gliding through the clouds — or jump into intense magical arena battles against enemies.

Never flown an RC aircraft before? No problem! The zero-gravity mode makes learning to fly easy and accessible.

Are you a professional or an RC aviation enthusiast? Then you’ll love the variable-gravity mode — it’s challenging, fun, and truly unique.

games.title: Arcane Horizon
games.description:
Embark on an epic journey in Arcane Horizon, an Open World Action RPG experience! Level up your character, roll for powerful allies and complete quests across a vast, stunning world. 

Explore rich environments, face dynamic challenges, and master unique abilities in full immersion. Dive into adventure and shape your destiny in a land filled with mystery and magic.

Ready to experience true freedom? Your adventure awaits!

games.title: ARCarCraft
games.description: ARCarCraft Car Assembly & Experience is an automotive design experience platform specifically created for the Meta Quest platform. Through immersive 3D environments and advanced MR technology, it allows users to conduct 1:1 realistic car assembly and operation experience in mixed reality spaces.

games.title: Arcaxer
games.description: A turn-based VR RPG with first person action oriented combat, and a 3rd person god-view overworld. Dodge enemy attacks with your body in battles and explore procedural dungeons in 3rd person.

games.title: Archemist!
games.description:
Archemist is a light-hearted potion-brewing game that takes place in your own home!

From your desk, you’ll receive magical orders and prepare ingredients by chopping, cooking, or extracting their essence to brew potions and test their fun effects. Unlock magical accessories and experiment with over 100 ingredients across 15 unique potions in this playful, hands-on magical experience.

games.title: Archer Target VR
games.description: in this game you'll use bows & arrows, or guns to hit various targets. The game includes idle (unmoving) targets, hovering targets, and teleporting targets that appear and disappear. Players must quickly aim and shoot the teleporting targets within five seconds before they vanish again. Test your precision and reflexes in this dynamic VR archery game! 🎯🏹

games.title: 아처리 랜드
games.description: 아처리 랜드는 싱글, 멀티 VR슈팅 게임입니다. 넓은 대지를 향해 활을 겨누어, 짜릿한 타격감을 즐겨 보세요!

games.title: Archery Master
games.description: Archery Master VR" is a single-player virtual reality archery game that offers an immersive and challenging experience. Available exclusively on the Meta Store, the game features various game modes, realistic graphics, and dynamic AI integration. Experience the thrill of archery in virtual reality with "Archery Master VR."

games.title: Archery RED
games.description: Move to a futuristic sci-fi world with a bow and arrow in your hands. Playing the role of an archer, the player's goal is to accurately shoot targets and defeat varied robo-enemies. Advanced mechanics and realistic shooting physics provide an amazing experience. Immerse yourself in the thrilling singleplayer campaign mode or test your skills in the endless endless mode. Are you ready for the challenge?

games.title: Archery World - Archery Game
games.description: Master the art of the bow in Archery World - Archery Game! Challenge yourself with precision target shooting, thrilling archery battles, and immersive environments.

games.title: Arcsmith
games.description: 미래를 건설하고, 과거를 수리하세요. 이제는 은하 가장자리의 우주 정거장 깊은 곳에서 은둔자의 삶을 살아가는 마스터 아크스미스, 코리스 딘의 이야기가 궁금하신가요? 딘의 도제가 되어 정거장에서의 생활에 필요한 수많은 기계들을 제작하고, 딘이 과거를 만회할 수 있게 도와주세요.

games.title: Are You Aware?
games.description: The poor bunnies have been put a spell on.  Only you can save them from their torment.  Sadly, the only way to save them, is to "relieve" them. Will you be aware enough?

games.title: AREA MAN LIVES
games.description:
AREA MAN LIVES. Or does he? A quirky radio drama unfolds around you in VR while you do your best to keep the radio station humming along as its new DJ. You record commercials, interview callers and try your best to piece together how your actions inside the station impact your listening audience.

Play to see why AREA MAN LIVES is a "Best Narrative Games of 2022" Official Selection on the Quest store, a Venice International Film Festival 2022 Selection, AND a Cannes XR 2022 Official Selection!

games.title: arena
games.description:
Fast action shooter, 19 levels, 3 difficulty settings. Immersive, 
No sickness. Fun, easy to master and challenging. No blood, gore, human shooting. Online scoreboard to challenge friends and family. No account, sold items, just plain fun from the start !

games.title: Arena ¥ Blitz
games.description: Game inspired by the underwater sport called Blitzball.

games.title: 애리조나 선샤인으로 (Arizona Sunshine®)
games.description: 오직 VR 플레이를 위해 만든 애리조나 선샤인으로® 좀비 재앙을 경험해보세요. 실전처럼 무기로 싸우고, 재앙 이후의 세계를 자유롭게 탐험하면서 VR에서 당신의 생존 본능을 실험해보세요. 좀비를 해치우면서 그 어느 때보다 스릴을 느끼실 겁니다.

games.title: Arizona Sunshine® 2
games.description: 당신의 오랜 친구, Fred를 만날 시간입니다. 팬들에게 사랑받는 VR 아포칼립스의 차세대 속편인 Arizona Sunshine® 2가 더욱 피비린내 가득한 좀비 액션을 선보입니다! 홀로 맞이하는 빌어먹을 세상의 종말 앞에 가장 큰 용기란 무엇일까요? 바로 새로운 베프 Buddy와 함께 세상을 구하는 것이죠.

games.title: Arizona Sunshine® Remake
games.description: 좀비 아포칼립스가 새롭게 다시 태어났습니다. Arizona Sunshine® Remake는 수상 경력에 빛나는 기존 게임을 고어가 빛나는 VR 그래픽과 차세대 VR 전투 및 무기로 완전히 다시, 더 좋게 만들어낸 게임입니다. 홀로 또는 최대 3명의 동료 생존자와 함께 좀비로 뒤덮인 포스트아포칼립스 상황의 미국 남서부에서 좀비들과 맞서세요.

games.title: ARK and ADE
games.description:
ARK and ADE는 네온 불빛으로 도배된 환경에서 80년대 아케이드 시대의 영광을 경험할 수 있는 액션 FPS 슈팅 게임입니다. 🤘😎

레트로 스타일과 미래지향적인 분위기가 결합된 스테이지에서 끝없이 날아오는 총알을 피하면서 몰려오는 적들과 인상적인 보스를 물리치세요. 불릿 타임, 실드, 양손 무기 등을 이용하고, 비밀과 트로피를 모으고, 파괴 가능한 환경과 엄폐물을 마음껏 부수면서 게임 속에 빠져 보세요. 동전을 넣고 플레이하세요! 🤖

games.title: Arkero
games.description: A VR fantasy MOBA, Co-op, and Singleplayer experience. Use one of three classes, the Archer, the Arbalist, and the Mage. Fight against each other in a MOBA setting, work together to stop waves of enemies, or test your skills in a Singleplayer campaign with each class!

games.title: ArmStrong VR
games.description: Step into the ultimate VR fitness challenge with ArmStrong VR! Run, dodge, and track your calories in real-time. Escape a terrifying monster in randomly generated mazes, climb the global leaderboard in the Jump challenge, and complete daily workout quests. Are you ready to sweat and activate BEAST MODE?

games.title: Arrow Master Knockdown
games.description: Arrow Master Knockdown is an intense VR archery game where precision meets pressure. Shoot rising can platforms through multiple waves, manage limited arrows, or race against time across challenging levels and modes.

games.title: Arrow Song2
games.description: " Archer of the Arrow Song 2" is an archery game with the historical background of Qin Shihuang's unification of China. Throughout the ten years of Qin's unification, there were 19 major battles. The game will lead players back to the magnificent Warring States Period, to experience Qin Shihuang's ambition to unify the six kingdoms, to conquer all corners of the country, and to write his own legend.

games.title: Arrowhead - Medieval Archery VR
games.description:
Become a master of the bow & arrow!
Hit all targets and waste no arrows to accumulate Stars and earn Gold. Buy new equipment and beat even the most challenging levels.

games.source_name: Art of Combat: Fighting Dragons Championship
games.title: Art of Combat: Fighting Dragons Championship
games.description:
Fight against 12 unique fighters with a complete set of martial arts techniques and combos, and 15 different special powers.
Feel a stunning immersive martial arts combat experience that will make other fighting games bite the dust!
You will have to train your striking, evasion, blocking and specials powers skills to become the toughest fighter.
Improve your stamina, body strength and technique while you have a great fighting time.
Unleash the dragon!

games.title: ART Puzzle
games.description:
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of art with the VR game ARTPuzzle and collect jigsaw puzzles with iconic work by the most famous masters.

Explore art galleries featuring paintings by artists of various eras, genres and countries, each with its own unique atmosphere and carefully selected paintings. Thanks to the great detail of the images, you will be able to pay attention to the smallest details of the paintings and reveal the author's idea in a new way.

games.title: Art Studio VR
games.description: Art Studio VR is an intuitive painting tool created for aspiring artists and visionary professionals. Create striking sketches, full-on paintings and beautiful textures on your own 3D models.

games.title: Artax
games.description: In Artax, you guide a toy soldier through a dreamlike world in search of Bulf, a character who has escaped from his box. Explore a fascinating miniature world with incredible details, an engaging atmosphere, and innovative gameplay. Help Artax overcome obstacles and enemies to return Bulf to his world and restore order to their magical universe.

games.title: Artistry Space
games.description: Unleash your creativity in Artistry Space, a virtual reality drawing app that lets you paint in both 2D and 3D environments. Use a variety of brushes to craft stunning artwork on a virtual canvas or bring your imagination to life in a dynamic 3D space. Whether you're sketching intricate designs or painting immersive landscapes, Artistry Space offers an unparalleled VR art experience. Step into a world where your creativity knows no bounds!

games.title: ARTO
games.description:
Unleash your creativity in ARTO!
Draw, paint, and play in 10 unique scenes using 1200+ templates and 500+ decals.
Whether you're doodling mandalas or making mirrored art, it's all about relaxing fun.

games.title: ArtQuest VR – 수백 개의 박물관
games.description: ArtQuest VR은 세계 최대의 미술관입니다. 루브르, 게티, 암스테르담 국립미술관, MoMA를 비롯한 수백 개 컬렉션에서 수십만 점의 회화, 조각, 유물을 만나 보세요. 예술가, 사조, 박물관별로 둘러보고, 좋아하는 작품을 다시 찾고, 새로운 예술가와 유물을 발견하며 수백 년의 예술을 원하는 속도로 여행하세요.

games.title: asdf
games.description: asdf is an amazing experience

games.title: Asgard's Wrath 2
games.description: Loki의 혼돈이 퍼져나가고 있습니다. 고유한 무기와 플레이스타일을 가진 필멸의 영웅들을 조종하여 신들이 기거하는 고대 이집트 영역을 가로질러 그를 추적하고, 사상 최대 규모에 버금가는 장대한 VR ARPG에 도전하세요. 치명적인 신화 속의 생물들과 싸우고, 임무를 완수하고, 장비를 제작하고, 퍼즐을 풀거나 충직한 야수들을 전사의 동료로 길들이면서, 방대하고도 자유로운 이동이 가능한 살아 숨 쉬는 세계를 탐험하세요. 역대 최고의 평가를 받은 VR 게임 중 하나의 속편에서 현실의 운명은 여러분의 손에 달려 있습니다.

games.title: Ashen Arrows
games.description: 애쉬엔 애로우즈는 로그라이크 웨이브 방어형 1인칭 VR 어드벤처 게임입니다. 플레이어는 궁수로서 끝없이 밀려오는 다양한 적들의 파도로부터 기지를 방어해야 합니다.다양한 기술, 화살, 강화 아이템을 활용하고, 적을 상대할 전략을 선택하세요. 가능성은 무한하며, 매 라운드와 플레이가 새로운 도전이 됩니다!"신의 도전" 에 뛰어들어 한계를 시험하거나, 내레이션이 담긴 스토리 모드 첫 맵을 탐험하며 영웅 사냥꾼의 사가와 세계의 종말을 향한 위대한 여정을 경험하세요!

games.title: Ashmyany Synagogue Reconstruction & Tour
games.description: Step inside the Great Synagogue of Ashmyany — a breathtaking virtual journey through a once-silent space, now reborn in light. Discover its history and vivid interior: the starry dome, zodiac signs, and the rising sun above the Torah Ark — all revived in immersive VR.
